title: Compatibility bridge and phasewise comms timetable for model-tag retirement
creator: Ava Ramos
description: Summary: This ticket coordinates a staged retirement of legacy model tags (v1-tagged endpoints) by providing a compatibility bridge, a migration guide, and a detailed communications timetable across teams. The goal is to minimize customer downtime and surprise behaviors while reclaiming model serving capacity and simplifying the catalog. Scope: - Identify impacted model tags and traffic split by customer tier and region. - Ship a compatibility shim that translates v1 tag requests to supported v2 variants where safe. - Produce migration guides, release notes, and in-console migration prompts. - Run a 6-week phased deprecation cadence with canary, opt-in migration, mandatory migration, and final cutoff windows. Success criteria: >95% of active customers migrate within the opt-in window, fewer than 5 P1 incidents related to behavioral regressions, and no regression in core latency SLOs for migrated traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility shim can translate 90% of v1 calls to v2 equivalents without semantic regressions (validated by eval suite)
Migration guide published and linked from Console and API docs
Cross-team readiness checklist completed (Eng, Docs, Support, Sales, Legal)
Release notes and in-product banners scheduled for each cadence milestone
Rollback and fallback mechanisms tested end-to-end
tasks: Inventory impacted tags and customer usage by region (ENG)
Design compatibility bridge behavior and failure semantics (ENG)
Author migration guide with code samples and automated migration scripts (PM + Docs)
Create release notes copy and templated email cadence (PM + Comms)
Design in-console migration nudges and prompts (DES)
Define monitoring dashboards and regression alerts (SRE/Observability)
comms_timeline: T-30d: Internal announcement + readiness prep notes to Eng/Docs/Support/Legal/Sales
T-21d: Publish migration guide draft and solicit feedback (Docs/Eng)
T-14d: Release notes draft ready; in-console banner copy approved by Design
T-7d: Public blog post + email to affected customers with opt-in migration window details
T+0 (canary start): Enable compatibility shim for 5% traffic; monitor 48h
T+7 (opt-in): Open in-console opt-in toggle for customers; targeted outreach by CS
T+28 (mandatory migration): Begin redirecting remaining traffic using shim and scheduled cutover windows
T+42 (final cutoff): Disable legacy tag acceptance and close migration runway, final customer notice
migration_steps: Run tag inventory job and publish customer-facing list of impacted tags
Ship compatibility shim behind feature flag; enable for internal test orgs
Publish migration CLI script and sample SDK patch (Python/Node) that updates tag references
Open opt-in in Console with one-click migration for eligible projects
Provide automatic rollback hooks and logging for any semantic mismatch
After opt-in window, run controlled redirects for remaining customers and create support workstreams for manual escalations
rollback_plan: If semantic regressions exceed thresholds (see monitoring runbook), immediately flip shim to disabled for affected customers, revert traffic to legacy runtime for those orgs, open bug triage with priority ENG-PRIORITY path, and pause mandatory migration until fixes are validated. Communication to customers includes incident summary, ETA, and interim mitigation steps.
metrics: Number of migration-related incidents by severity
Semantic regression rate measured by eval prompt suite
Average request latency delta for migrated traffic
Support ticket volume for migration-related issues
